title: Structure-conditioned realization of paracontrolled coefficients as rapidly decreasing modeled distributions through Hopf extension and descent
difficulty_reason: H2: direct use of the old character-model construction on the coefficient Hopf algebra fails because its formal derivatives are linearly dependent and assumption C need not hold. The author constructs a free enlarged Hopf algebra with the graded coefficient symbols and their derivatives, applies the reused analytic character-model theorem there, and then identifies the precise compensated Taylor identities that make the character factor through the polynomial-relation quotient. The link from coaction coefficient increments to model bounds yields the modeled-distribution criterion. This algebraic compatibility/free-to-quotient construction is the new nonroutine burden, while the old2062 H3 two-scale analytic estimates are explicitly reused and not counted again.
